text: BAM share rose 1.96 percentage points over 25 hours and 1.61 percentage points over 7 days, reaching 37.5% of Solana stake. Concentration is elevated: ams-mainnet-bam-2-tee holds 24.6% of BAM stake, and the node Nakamoto coefficient is 3. Leadership changes have been whale-driven routing, with 66 top-node handoffs in this window, not evidence of a structural rollover.
